# Dreaming Ages History

Dreaming Ages History is a YouTube channel and podcast of calm, researched history stories made for sleep. Episodes are usually about two hours long, with no mid-video ads and no cliff-hangers. Scripts are written and fact-checked from published sources. Narration is AI-generated text-to-speech, which is disclosed on the site and in the videos.

Start here:
- https://dreamingages.com/ — home
- https://dreamingages.com/our-approach/ — how episodes are made
- https://dreamingages.com/episodes/ — episode pages, with summaries, chapters and sources (and a spoken-narration transcript on the fuller pages)
- https://dreamingages.com/sleep/ — free bedtime companions
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@DreamingAgesHistory
- Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/podcast/id6819722484
